feature: Guarded purge of eighteen non-project production records
route: Production PM database, AI/RAG database, and Supabase Storage

flows.name: Exact-target rehearsal
steps: Resolve all eighteen manifest targets by exact database identity
Inventory PM, meeting, RAG document, and exact storage dependencies
Run the complete database deletion sequence and roll it back
flows.expectedOutcome: All eighteen targets resolve uniquely and the complete database purge succeeds without committing

flows.name: Complete production purge
steps: Delete every reviewed exact project-folder storage object
Apply the manifest-bound PM and RAG database purge
Replay the exact RAG document IDs from the matching apply receipt
flows.expectedOutcome: No active project, meeting, non-audit app reference, RAG project/document reference, or exact project-folder object remains

claims.description: The destructive operation was bound to the exact eighteen user-selected records
Projects, meetings, project-owned app data, RAG knowledge, and exact storage files were deleted
Wrong confirmation, target drift, and missing or incomplete verification receipts stop loudly
Shared master records were excluded and historical audit evidence remains without active project data
